citations.quote: the delta–gamma approximation, where first- and second-order derivatives are used
In the scenario-based approach to measuring the risk of a portfolio, one considers a number of possible future risk-factor changes

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Sensitivity-based risk measurement approximates portfolio loss through delta and delta–gamma derivative exposures, while simulation/scenario-based measurement evaluates the portfolio under a set of postulated future risk-factor changes; McNeil Ch.2/Ch.9 contrast the two routes.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Sensitivity-Based vs Simulation-Based Risk Measurement
